sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Worries over trifles; impulsive thoughts of
suicide; constant state of fear and nervousness. Head-
ache makes him apprehensive about trifles; worse go-
ing upstairs or rapid motion. Dull, hazy ache of head.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Poor appetite. Much gas in stomach and
bowels. Cramps in pit of stomach, worse at night.
Stomach feels heavy and overloaded. Cramp in abdo-
men below umbilicus. Bowels irregular. Stool accom-
panied by pain and straining.

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Tired feeling and dull pain in small of back,
worse walking. Pain in ankles and up back of leg.
Pain low down in back and extremities.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Pronounced sleeplessness; dreams of serious
nature while, asleep.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Perspiration on slight exertion. Profuse, of-
fensive sweat of feet. Crumbling away of finger-nails.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, at night, fast walking, going up-
stairs.
